title: Rafael and the Static
author: Zephyrine Zhou
blurb: Juniper Thackeray, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
